arStrings.szText: Wonderful! I knew you were a capable fighter, just knew it. You have that look about you. Never had a doubt.
All right, meet me in Drunkard’s Row, at the sign of the Stumbling Gull. Tell no one, and make sure you're not followed. They'll ask you to speak a word—it's "gouge."
You keep your guard up and your head down, and we'll both come out of this with pockets jingling. It's your lucky day, my friend, and mine as well.
